name: Easy Creamy Potato-Chickpea Casserole with Bell Pepper, Zucchini, Tomato & Cheese

ingredients.name: potatoes O'Brien (frozen diced potatoes with peppers & onions)

instructions.primary_message: Place potatoes in a large baking dish, drizzle with oil, and stir to coat. Place baking dish in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast while you prep the rest of the casserole.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (794 g) bag potatoes O'Brien (frozen diced potatoes with peppers & onions)
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and trim zucchini. Halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Place in a medium bowl.
Drain and rinse chickpeas. Add to the bowl with the zucchini, along with cream of cheddar soup and seasoning, then stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (254 g) can garbanzo beans (chickpeas)
2 (298 g) can cheddar cheese soup
2 tsp garlic & herb seasoning

instructions.primary_message: Remove baking dish from the oven, add the chickpea mixture (do not stir), and spread out in an even layer. Tightly cover with aluminum foil, return casserole to the oven, and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove casserole from the oven, uncover, and sprinkle with cheese. Return to the oven and continue to bake until cheese is bubbly and golden, 20-30 minutes more. Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cups triple cheddar cheese blend, shredded

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide casserole between plates and enjoy!
